how: Browser fetch against api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions with the user's configured key, from the running app tab. Ceiling probe sends max_tokens: 999999 and reads the 400 the API itself returns, which names the per-model limit. Positive control sends the value we intend to ship and requires HTTP 200.
errorMessageVerbatim: max_tokens is too large: 999999. This model supports at most <N> completion tokens, whereas you provided 999999.
conclusion: Smallest ceiling across the four supported OpenAI presets is 16384. 16000 is accepted by all four and is the value shipped.
notMeasured: Anthropic. No Anthropic connection is configured in this app, so its per-model ceiling was not probed.
